answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks using collateralized slashing bonds. Each agent locks tokens into an admission jetty to participate. When a falcon auditor detects a conflicting echo of signed state commitments, the protocol slashes the offending node's deposit. This forces adversaries to risk scarce financial capital per identity rather than spawning costless clones. However, high deposit thresholds inherently favor wealthy actors over resource-constrained agents.
